decides: 成品长什么样、给谁看——动画帧、设定图、漫画、游戏、周边，每种载体有自己的规格与铁律。一切的根
note: 这是「关联创作」的主维度：同一套视觉模块，载体不同成品形态完全不同

items.prompt: animation key visual frame staged as a single story beat, cinematic composition with clear subject hierarchy, motion implied through line and pose rather than blur, broadcast-quality framing
items.note: 一帧一个节拍，构图服务叙事

items.prompt: anime character design sheet, full-body frontal view with proportional construction marks, costume broken into labeled detail callouts, consistent line weight, neutral standing pose on empty ground
items.note: 可复现性优先：比例、服装结构、配色都要能被另一个画师抄走

items.prompt: anime expression sheet, the same character repeated in a grid of nine head-and-shoulders portraits, each carrying one clean emotion with distinct eye and brow shapes, identical lighting and angle across all cells
items.note: 同角度同光线是纪律，变的是眉眼嘴

items.prompt: black-and-white manga page layout, stacked rectangular panels narrating one continuous beat, ink solid fills with cross-hatching and screentone gradients, converging speed lines driving the eye, clean borders with generous gutters, speech balloons left empty
items.note: 文字一律后期排版，画面留白给对话框

items.prompt: vertical-scroll webtoon episode layout, one tall continuous composition built for phone scrolling, cinematic pacing with generous vertical gaps between beats, all important shapes clear of side margins
items.note: 竖屏是铁律：任何关键形状不碰侧边

items.prompt: light novel illustration, one character staged in a narrative moment with soft atmospheric background, color composition tuned to sit beside a page of text, restrained palette with one accent, generous uncluttered area around the figure
items.note: 插图让位给文字：视觉重量克制

items.prompt: game character key art, dynamic three-quarter pose with costume readable at UI scale, rim-lit separation from background, polished finish with clean silhouette, composed to survive thumbnail reduction
items.note: 小尺寸可读性是第一纪律

items.prompt: game item icon, single object centered in a circular or rounded-square frame, readable silhouette at 64 pixels, exactly three value shades per material, subtle inner glow, no text on the icon itself

trading card game art, central character or creature in a dramatic stance, layered frame zones reserved for name and rules text, rich illustration bleeding to card edges, consistent lighting direction across a set
items.note: 画面给文字框让位，系列内光线必须一致

items.prompt: VTuber Live2D character key art, bright design appealing at thumbnail size, highly saturated coordinated scheme with two dominant hues plus white and one accent, layered accessories, large expressive eyes with multiple sparkle highlights, open frontal pose on a simple gradient circle
items.note: 直播框里看板娘的标准规格

items.prompt: merchandise design illustration for physical goods, character or motif simplified into clean reproducible shapes, limited palette matching print process, transparent or single-color background, no fine detail that dies at small print size
items.note: 印刷工艺说了算：细线会并、渐变会脏

items.prompt: anime poster key visual, theatrical composition with strong vertical or diagonal thrust, layered depth from foreground character to distant world, title space reserved at top or center, saturated theatrical palette
items.note: 一张图扛一部作品的印象

items.prompt: anime storyboard frame, rough gestural drawing prioritizing camera language and staging over finish, shot type and movement annotated visually, simplified figures with clear silhouettes, sequential reading order
items.note: 分镜是给剧组看的，不是给观众看的

items.prompt: doujinshi cover illustration, fan-art staging of a beloved pairing or character in an original moment, expressive dynamic pose, decorative border frame, palette tuned to the pairing mood
items.note: 二次创作的情绪浓度优先
